summary: Iter 598: Tested ABS Revenue Dashboard endpoint + Weekly Digest send-now rebase/abs blocks and frontend rendering. All 7 backend tests pass; frontend renders the 📊 ABS Gelir Panosu card with total (£120), monthly bar chart svg, per-attribute horizontal bars, plus regression items (Robot Fiyat Önerileri, Otomatik mod toggle, Oda–Özellik Matrisi).
critical_code_review_comments: weekly_digest._rebase_section_html uses f-string with `{r.get('loss'):,}` — if loss is None the format spec crashes. Should coerce to 0/skip when None.

revenue-dashboard uses 183-day cutoff on created_at and clamps to start_month..cur_month; this can drop the earliest partial month at the 183-day boundary — acceptable but consider using calendar-based 6-month start for consistent windows.

abs_selling.compute_price_suggestions counts ANY booking (regardless of abs_total>0) in `total` but only sums `sold` via abs_attributes — attach_rate denominator may be inflated vs revenue-dashboard which uses abs_total>0 for abs_b count.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter598 covers /api/abs/{pid}/revenue-dashboard (auth, shape, no future months, monthly<=6, ordering, total match), /api/weekly-digest/{pid}/send-now (forced by default, returns digest with rebase key + abs_price_changes_7d int, requires auth), and /api/abs/{pid}/price-log regression. Frontend: Ctrl+K → 'Özellik bazlı' → data-testid abs-revenue-dashboard/abs-total-revenue/abs-revenue-chart/abs-revenue-by-attr all render. Emails are mocked (email_outbox).
